description.en: Seattle sits between Puget Sound and Lake Washington in the Pacific Northwest. It is where I pursue my undergraduate studies at the University of Washington.
description.zh: 西雅图位于美国太平洋西北地区，坐落在普吉特海湾与华盛顿湖之间。我在这里的华盛顿大学攻读本科。

description.en: Chengdu, my hometown, is the capital of Sichuan Province in southwestern China, on the western edge of the Sichuan Basin. It is famous for pandas and hotpot.
description.zh: 成都是我的家乡，也是中国西南地区四川省的省会，位于四川盆地西缘。这里以熊猫和火锅闻名。
